logical_clock.wire_timestamp: relative source-coordinate tick as existing fixed_seq_clock sample; NOT Unix seconds or milliseconds
logical_clock.source_revision_rule: same identity/seq/timestamp, increased revision, new received_at and changed raw_text/price
logical_clock.first_known: not supplied by this fixture; actual S state/frontier/time must be recorded later

sending_plan.seed_phase: 96 individual accepted-input requests in source order, each plans an Advance; seed-input.json is an aggregate convenience, not evidence of 96 commits
sending_plan.live_phase_start_condition: after seed schedule completes and its actual accepted/committed frontiers are recorded; acquire first fixed-cut Snapshot token/page, then start live before subsequent pages
sending_plan.live_phase: 64 operations on fixed phase-relative deadlines; do not wait for consumer ack or page completion
sending_plan.late_send: record planned and actual times/backlog/reason; never shift all remaining deadlines to hide lateness
sending_plan.advance: one request per accepted operation, outcome/actual cut recorded; no claim that one attempt equals one Commit
sending_plan.wall_time_note: planned host monotonic deadlines are independent of 1-second logical event steps; 2Hz feed gives a deliberately faster logical clock, not measured timing
sending_plan.fault_and_reconnect_schedule: not generated here; later bind to actual native cuts and predefined experiment phases
